name: CanTp
description: Configuration of the CanTp (CAN Transport Protocol) module.

children.name: CanTpConfig
children.description: This container contains the configuration parameters and sub containers of the AUTOSAR CanTp module.

children.name: CanTpMainFunctionPeriod
children.description: Allow to configure the time for the MainFunction (as float in seconds). The CanTpMainFunctionPeriod should be assigned a value which is optimal regarding all of the timers configured for CanTp in TX and RX data transfer i.e. the differences from the configured timing should be as small as possible. Please note: This period shall be the same as call cycle time of the periodic task were CanTp Main function is called.

children.name: CanTpMaxChannelCnt
children.description: Maximum number of channels. This parameter is needed only in case of post-build loadable implementation using static memory allocation.

children.name: CanTpChannel
children.description: This container contains the configuration parameters of the CanTp channel.

children.name: CanTpChannelMode
children.description: The CAN Transport Layer supports half and full duplex channel modes.

children.name: CanTpRxNSdu
children.description: The following parameters needs to be configured for each CAN N-SDU that the CanTp module receives via the CanTpChannel.

children.name: CanTpBs
children.description: Sets the number of N-PDUs the CanTp receiver allows the sender to send, before waiting for an authorization to continue transmission of the following N-PDUs.For further details on this parameter value see ISO 15765-2 specification.

children.name: CanTpNar
children.description: Value in seconds of the N_Ar timeout. N_Ar is the time for transmission of a CAN frame (any N_PDU) on the receiver side.

children.name: CanTpNbr
children.description: Value in seconds of the performance requirement for (N_Br + N_Ar). N_Br is the elapsed time between the receiving indication of a FF or CF or the transmit confirmation of a FC, until the transmit request of the next FC.

children.name: CanTpNcr
children.description: Value in seconds of the N_Cr timeout. N_Cr is the time until reception of the next Consecutive Frame N_PDU.

children.name: CanTpRxAddressingFormat
children.description: Declares which communication addressing mode is supported for this RxNSdu. Definition of Enumeration values:

metadata.INTRODUCTION: CanTpStandard to use normal addressing format. CanTpExtended to use extended addressing format. CanTpMixed to use mixed 11 bit addressing format. CanTpNormalFixed to use normal fixed addressing format. CanTpMixed29Bit to use mixed 29 bit addressing format.
metadata.LITERALS: CANTP_EXTENDED AUTOSAR_ECUC CANTP_MIXED AUTOSAR_ECUC CANTP_MIXED29BIT AUTOSAR_ECUC CANTP_NORMALFIXED AUTOSAR_ECUC CANTP_STANDARD AUTOSAR_ECUC

children.name: CanTpRxNSduId
children.description: Unique identifier user by the upper layer to call CanTp_CancelReceive, CanTp_ChangeParameter and CanTp_ReadParameter.

children.name: CanTpRxPaddingActivation
children.description: Defines if the receive frame uses padding or not. This parameter is restricted to 8 byte N-PDUs.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: Definition of enumeration values: CanTpOn: The N-PDU received uses padding for SF, FC and the last CF. (N-PDU length is always >= 8 bytes in case of CAN 2.0) CanTpOff: The N-PDU received does not use padding for SF, CF and the last CF. (N-PDU length is dynamic - any valid DLC value). Note: The mandatory mapping to the next higher valid DLC value for N-PDUs with a length > 8 bytes is not affected by this parameter.

children.name: CanTpRxTaType
children.description: Declares the communication type of this Rx N-SDU.

metadata.LITERALS: CANTP_CANFD_FUNCTIONAL AUTOSAR_ECUC CANTP_CANFD_PHYSICAL AUTOSAR_ECUC CANTP_FUNCTIONAL AUTOSAR_ECUC CANTP_PHYSICAL AUTOSAR_ECUC

children.name: CanTpRxWftMax
children.description: This parameter indicates how many Flow Control wait N-PDUs can be consecutively transmitted by the receiver. It is local to the node and is not transmitted inside the FC protocol data unit.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: CanTpRxWftMax is used to avoid sender nodes being potentially hooked-up in case of a temporarily reception inability on the part of the receiver nodes, whereby the sender could be waiting continuously.

children.name: CanTpSTmin
children.description: Sets the duration of the minimum time the CanTp sender shall wait between the transmissions of two CF N-PDUs.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: For further details on this parameter value see ISO 15765-2 specification.

children.name: CanTpRxNSduRef
children.description: Reference to a Pdu in the COM-Stack.

children.name: CanTpNAe
children.description: This container is required for each RxNSdu and TxNSdu with AddressingFormat CANTP_MIXED or CANTP_MIXED29BIT.

children.name: CanTpNAe
children.description: This parameter contains the transport protocol address extension value.

children.name: CanTpNSa
children.description: This container is required for each RxNSdu and TxNSdu with RxTaType CANTP_PHYSICAL and CanTpAddressingFormat CANTP_EXTENDED. When DynIdSupport is enabled, this container is also required for each TxNSdu with AddressingFormat CANTP_NORMALFIXED or CANTP_MIXED29BIT. When DynIdSupport is enabled and GenericConnectionSupport is not enabled, this container is also required for each RxNSdu with AddressingFormat CANTP_NORMALFIXED or CANTP_MIXED29BIT.

children.name: CanTpNSa
children.description: This parameter contains the transport protocol source address value.

children.name: CanTpNTa
children.description: This container is required for each RxNSdu and TxNSdu with AddressingFormat CANTP_EXTENDED. When DynIdSupport is enabled, this container is also required for each RxNSdu with AddressingFormat CANTP_NORMALFIXED or CANTP_MIXED29BIT. When DynIdSupport is enabled and GenericConnectionSupport is not enabled, this container is also required for each TxNSdu with AddressingFormat CANTP_NORMALFIXED or CANTP_MIXED29BIT.

children.name: CanTpNTa
children.description: This parameter contains the transport protocol target address value.

children.name: CanTpRxNPdu
children.description: Used for grouping of the ID of a PDU and the Reference to a PDU.

children.name: CanTpRxNPduId
children.description: The N-PDU identifier attached to the RxNsdu is identified by CanTpRxNSduId.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: Each RxNsdu identifier is linked to only one SF/FF/CF N-PDU identifier. Nevertheless, in the case of extended or mixed addressing format, the same N-PDU identifier can be used for several N-SDU identifiers. The distinction is made by the N_TA or N_AE value (first data byte of SF or FF frames).

children.name: CanTpRxNPduRef
children.description: Reference to a Pdu in the COM-Stack.

children.name: CanTpTxFcNPdu
children.description: Used for grouping of the ID of a PDU and the Reference to a PDU.

children.name: CanTpTxFcNPduConfirmationPduId
children.description: Handle Id to be used by the CanIf to confirm the transmission of the CanTpTxFcNPdu to the CanIf module.

children.name: CanTpTxFcNPduRef
children.description: Reference to a Pdu in the COM-Stack.

children.name: CanTpTxNSdu
children.description: The following parameters needs to be configured for each CAN N-SDU that the CanTp module transmits via the CanTpChannel.

children.name: CanTpNas
children.description: Value in second of the N_As timeout. N_As is the time for transmission of a CAN frame (any N_PDU) on the part of the sender.

children.name: CanTpNbs
children.description: Value in seconds of the N_Bs timeout. N_Bs is the time of transmission until reception of the next Flow Control N_PDU.

children.name: CanTpNcs
children.description: Value in seconds of the performance requirement of (N_Cs + N_As). N_Cs is the time which elapses between the transmit request of a CF N-PDU until the transmit request of the next CF N-PDU.

children.name: CanTpTc
children.description: Switch for enabling Transmit Cancellation and Receive Cancellation.

children.name: CanTpTxAddressingFormat
children.description: Declares which communication addressing format is supported for this TxNSdu. Definition of Enumeration values:

metadata.INTRODUCTION: CanTpStandard to use normal addressing format. CanTpExtended to use extended addressing format. CanTpMixed to use mixed 11 bit addressing format. CanTpNormalFixed to use normal fixed addressing format. CanTpMixed29Bit to use mixed 29 bit addressing format.
metadata.LITERALS: CANTP_EXTENDED AUTOSAR_ECUC CANTP_MIXED AUTOSAR_ECUC CANTP_MIXED29BIT AUTOSAR_ECUC CANTP_NORMALFIXED AUTOSAR_ECUC CANTP_STANDARD AUTOSAR_ECUC

children.name: CanTpTxNSduId
children.description: Unique identifier to a structure that contains all useful information to process the transmission of a TxNsdu.

children.name: CanTpTxPaddingActivation
children.description: Defines if the transmit frame use padding or not. This parameter is restricted to 8 byte N-PDUs.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: Definition of Enumeration values: CanTpOn The transmit N-PDU uses padding for SF, FC and the last CF. (N-PDU length is always 8 bytes in case of CAN 2.0) CanTpOff The transmit N-PDU does not use padding for SF, CF and the last CF. (N-PDU length is dynamic - any valid DLC value). Note: The mandatory mapping to the next higher valid DLC value for N-PDUs with a length > 8 bytes is not affected by this parameter.

children.name: CanTpTxTaType
children.description: Declares the communication type of this TxNsdu.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: Enumeration values: CanTpPhysical. Used for 1:1 communication. CanTpFunctional. Used for 1:n communication.

children.name: CanTpTxNSduRef
children.description: Reference to a Pdu in the COM-Stack.

children.name: CanTpNAe
children.description: This container is required for each RxNSdu and TxNSdu with AddressingFormat CANTP_MIXED or CANTP_MIXED29BIT.

children.name: CanTpNAe
children.description: This parameter contains the transport protocol address extension value.

children.name: CanTpNSa
children.description: This container is required for each RxNSdu and TxNSdu with RxTaType CANTP_PHYSICAL and CanTpAddressingFormat CANTP_EXTENDED. When DynIdSupport is enabled, this container is also required for each TxNSdu with AddressingFormat CANTP_NORMALFIXED or CANTP_MIXED29BIT. When DynIdSupport is enabled and GenericConnectionSupport is not enabled, this container is also required for each RxNSdu with AddressingFormat CANTP_NORMALFIXED or CANTP_MIXED29BIT.

children.name: CanTpNSa
children.description: This parameter contains the transport protocol source address value.

children.name: CanTpNTa
children.description: This container is required for each RxNSdu and TxNSdu with AddressingFormat CANTP_EXTENDED. When DynIdSupport is enabled, this container is also required for each RxNSdu with AddressingFormat CANTP_NORMALFIXED or CANTP_MIXED29BIT. When DynIdSupport is enabled and GenericConnectionSupport is not enabled, this container is also required for each TxNSdu with AddressingFormat CANTP_NORMALFIXED or CANTP_MIXED29BIT.

children.name: CanTpNTa
children.description: This parameter contains the transport protocol target address value.

children.name: CanTpRxFcNPdu
children.description: Used for grouping of the ID of a PDU and the Reference to a PDU.

children.name: CanTpRxFcNPduId
children.description: N-PDU identifier attached to the FC N-PDU of this TxNsdu identified by CanTpTxNSduId.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: Each TxNsdu identifier is linked to one Rx FC N-PDU identifier only. However, in the case of extended addressing format, the same FC N-PDU identifier can be used for several N-SDU identifiers. The distinction is made by means of the N_TA value (first data byte of FC frames).

children.name: CanTpRxFcNPduRef
children.description: Reference to a Pdu in the COM-Stack.

children.name: CanTpTxNPdu
children.description: Used for grouping of the ID of a PDU and the Reference to a PDU.

children.name: CanTpTxNPduConfirmationPduId
children.description: Handle Id to be used by the CanIf to confirm the transmission of the CanTpTxNPdu to the CanIf module.

children.name: CanTpTxNPduRef
children.description: Reference to a Pdu in the COM-Stack.

children.name: CanTpGeneral
children.description: This container contains the general configuration parameters of the CanTp module.

children.name: CanTpChangeParameterApi
children.description: This parameter, if set to true, enables the CanTp_ChangeParameterRequest Api for this Module.

children.name: CanTpDevErrorDetect
children.description: Switches the Default Error Tracer (Det) detection and notification ON or OFF.

children.name: CanTpDynIdSupport
children.description: Enable support for dynamic ID handling via N-PDU MetaData.

children.name: CanTpFlexibleDataRateSupport
children.description: Enable support for CAN FD frames.

children.name: CanTpGenericConnectionSupport
children.description: Enable support for the handling of generic connections using N-SDUs with MetaData. Requires CanTpDynIdSupport.

children.name: CanTpPaddingByte
children.description: Used for the initialization of unused bytes with a certain value

children.name: CanTpReadParameterApi
children.description: This parameter, if set to true, enables the CanTp_ReadParameterApi for this module.

children.name: CanTpVersionInfoApi
children.description: The function CanTp_GetVersionInfo is configurable (On/Off) by this configuration parameter.
